text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash, victor of multiple GⅠs at 
Tokyo Racecourse. Still fresh in memory is 
the Tenno Sho (Autumn)—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She looked truly beautiful as she dropped 
to her knees in victory before her 
parents. When the Trainer tells her so, 
she gives an embarrassed smile.
